🗓 **TAWG Daily Catch-up**
_2026-10-25 23:00 → 2026-10-26 23:00 UTC_

## ⚡ **Highlights**

> **DEILS v1 authenticated profile-binding becomes normative** — both open PRs merged to main, setting a stable foundation for the next phase of spec work. [tg:tawg:5848]

> **OTS spec with test vectors published for group review** — the proposal and its verification vectors landed at a pinned commit before any service code was written, giving the group a clean review window. [tg:tawg:5856]

> **Same-day review loop closed on the anchor-profile spec** — feedback from Echo-Merlini was fully incorporated and re-pinned within hours, completing a full round-trip spec iteration without touching any implementation. [tg:tawg:5862]

## 🤝 **What moved**

### DEILS

_The v1 authenticated profile-binding requirement landed as normative, and the group moved immediately into a spec-first review cycle for the next extension._

- Pavlo (@pavlentyy82) **Merged** both DEILS PRs to main at final commit 28976c80, making the v1 authenticated profile-binding requirement normative and giving every downstream spec and implementation effort a stable reference point. [tg:tawg:5848]
- Baby Blue Viper **Shared** the OTS extension proposal a day early, explicitly holding all builds until the group agrees, which keeps the decision process transparent and lowers the cost of changing direction. [tg:tawg:5850]
- Baby Blue Viper **Published** the OTS spec and test vectors at a pinned commit with no service code written yet, creating a concrete reviewable artifact before any implementation commitment is made. [tg:tawg:5856]
- Baby Blue Viper **Incorporated** all review feedback from Echo-Merlini into a new pinned spec, completing a spec-only iteration loop that resolved open issues before any build dependency was introduced. [tg:tawg:5862]
- Baby Blue Viper **Confirmed** the pin-update process at a new commit after Echo-Merlini's clean re-run, demonstrating a repeatable workflow for future spec iterations that keeps the group synchronized on the current pinned state. [tg:tawg:5868]

### VECA

_Conformance scope for VECA came into sharper focus as existing verification and semantic-mapping work was surfaced for alignment._

- Jimmy Shi (@jimmyshi) **Highlighted** active conformance work on VECA as a meaningful parallel track alongside the DEILS milestone, helping the group see how verification standards connect across both efforts. [tg:tawg:5858]
- Pavlo (@pavlentyy82) **Surfaced** existing zkIE native verification and ERC-8274 semantic mapping work already present in VECA — including pinned proof evidence and explicit guarantee bodies — giving the group a concrete starting point for conformance alignment with the new DEILS normative baseline. [tg:tawg:5865]

### ERC-8183

_The Agentic Commerce forum thread advanced the incentive and resolution design with targeted outside input._

- On the ERC-8183 thread, a contributor posed a focused question about whether a missing incentive to invoke the resolution path is the core design gap, sharpening the problem statement for whoever takes up the next draft. [post #419](https://ethereum-magicians.org/t/erc-8183-agentic-commerce/27902/419)
- On the same thread, a contributor acknowledged external text-checking by a forum member and flagged the findings as a data point for the next drafting pass, keeping outside review connected to the normative work. [post #434](https://ethereum-magicians.org/t/erc-8183-agentic-commerce/27902/434)

## 🚀 **Next up**

### 💡 **Ideas to follow**
- The link between DEILS anchor-profile and VECA's zkIE verification path is now explicitly on the table — exploring whether the two proof evidence models can align or share structure could reduce duplication across both specs.
- The resolution-incentive gap raised on the ERC-8183 thread could become the basis for a scoped design session or a targeted follow-up forum question.

### ✅ **TODOs**
- Group to review the OTS spec and test vectors before Tuesday so the build decision can be made with full consensus.
- Scope the conformance alignment between DEILS and VECA, building on the zkIE and ERC-8274 mapping work surfaced today.
- ERC-8183: carry the resolution-incentive data point into the next normative drafting pass.

## 🤖 **Trusty's take**

> **Today's spark:** Two PRs merged in the morning, a spec with vectors live by midday, reviewed and re-pinned the same afternoon — the spec-before-code discipline held across an entire day of rapid handoffs.
>
> When the whole team runs on the same "spec first, build later" rhythm, the iteration loop gets very short. Keep the relay going! 🏃
